overflowLinks._why: DV-100 item 7 ends with "Check this box if you need more space to describe the abuse. You can use form DV-101" - which asks a filer to predict, before writing a word, whether what they are about to say fits in a box whose size they cannot see. They need more space exactly when they have used more than the box holds, and the box has been measured.
overflowLinks._whyBeyond: DV-101 item 5 carries the same escape - "Check here if you need more space. Attach a sheet of paper" - and asking it was the same mistake one form further on. Past what both boxes hold there is a third thing that is true and knowable: the filer has more to say than the packet can print, and a sheet of their own is the only place left for it.

computedFields._why: DV-100 item 32 asks for the number of extra pages attached. A filer cannot count them and the debug fill answered 100. The packet knows: the pages of every attachment being filed, plus one for each separate sheet already promised.
computedFields._whyAttachedTo: Counted along what each form says it is attached to, not along what switches it on. DV-108 is attached to DV-105, which is attached to DV-100, so its pages are part of the stack handed in with this form; DV-140 is attached to DV-110, a separate order, so its pages are not - and counting every conditional form as an attachment had put DV-140 in, making this 18 where it is 12.

alwaysShown.why: Item 2 follows item 1 whether or not the filer has a lawyer; the lawyer question is the last of item 1.

alwaysShown.question: relationship_to_person_to_restrain
alwaysShown.why: Item 3 follows item 2 whatever the lawyer answer was; 'The Person to Restrain' is one question and rejoins right after it.

alwaysShown.question: recent_restraining_orders
alwaysShown.why: Item 4 follows item 3 whatever the relationship was.

alwaysShown.question: other_court_case_involvement
alwaysShown.why: Item 4b follows 4a whether or not there are restraining orders.

alwaysShown.question: other_protected_people
alwaysShown.why: Item 8 follows item 7, regardless of the attached-page answer.

alwaysShown.question: animal_order_sole_possession_requested_yes
alwaysShown.why: Item 16b(3) is a separate box in the same check-all-that-apply list as 16b(2).

alwaysShown.question: abuse_expense
alwaysShown.why: Item 23 follows item 22 whether or not a special finding was asked for.

alwaysShown.question: child_support_situation
alwaysShown.why: Item 24 follows item 23 the same way.

alwaysShown.question: other_protected_people_reason_for_protection
alwaysShown.why: Item 8(2) follows 8(1) whatever the extra-page answer. It waits on the protect-others Yes: it used to be asked after No as well, which this note once claimed had been verified.

autofilledFields.why: A signature date has one correct answer and the form already knows it.
Same, for the lawyer signature block.
The printed name under a signature is the name given on page 1.
The lawyer names themselves once, in their own block.
